name: OVO Painting
address: 5064 Roswell Rd B202, Office A, Atlanta, GA 30342, United States

reviews.text:
OVO Painting did a FANTASTIC job!!!

OVO Painting exceeded every expectation. They recently completed a full paint job on my mother’s home, and the results are stunning — fresh, clean, and beautifully detailed. The transformation truly elevated the entire space.

What impressed us most was the leadership behind the work. The owner and Project Manager provided outstanding customer service from the very first conversation. They were friendly, professional, and took the time to clearly explain the scope of the project and the warranties in a way that made everything easy to understand. Their transparency and communication set the tone for a smooth experience.

My mother especially appreciated how accurate their timeline was. They delivered exactly when they said they would — no delays, no surprises. She is extremely satisfied with both the process and the final result.

OVO Painting is fair, reliable, and committed to quality. If you’re looking for a painting company you can trust, we highly recommend contacting them for a free quote. You’ll be glad you did.

Sebastian and his team did an extraordinary job resurfacing my kitchen cabinets.. the painting crew did an excellent job and were extremely professional and capable… I can’t say enough about the above excellent job they did. Sebastian led the team and went above and beyond to ensure the project went smoothly and my vision and expectations were met.. My kitchen cabinets look fantastic and the matching wall also looks fantastic.. thank you guys for all you did to ensure my home was immaculate upon completion…  I can’t wait to use them again. HUGE KUDOS….

We were so fortunate to have found Sebastian and his crew! We wanted to paint soon after we moved in, but life happened and we put painting on the back burner. Sebastian had already done measurements for us and sent us a quote. Fast forward a year later, we contacted him and was able to get our rooms painted very quickly! The crew was super kind and communication was impeccable! The painting was done super quickly - three areas in a day! They were clean and tidy and walls were evenly coated. Would highly recommend!!!

I had an amazing experience with OVO Painting! Sebastian and his crew did a fantastic job painting my home. From start to finish they were professional, punctual, detail-oriented, and clearly took pride in their work. The quality of the paint job exceeded my expectations with great attention to detail and everything was left neat and tidy when they finished. Sebastian was communicative, easy to work with, and made the entire process smooth and stress-free. My home looks completely refreshed and beautiful. Highly recommend OVO Painting to anyone looking for high-quality work and a reliable team!

Sebastian & his crew from OVO Painting does outstanding work! Had a roof leak that damaged the interior walls & some framing that was unseen till damage was horrible.They came replaced damaged framing, replaced insulation,hung & finished drywall, painted, & replaced trim. Very fast, efficient,detailed,& great prices. All work done was top notch professional & highly recommended them to anyone.

OVO Painting is outstanding and I cannot recommend them enough! From the initial quote to the finished job, this team truly treats you right. You feel the care and attention to detail from day one, and the quality of work, competitive pricing, and smooth experience throughout my project made it all so enjoyable.

When I hit paint color selection overload, they stepped right in and helped me work through it to decide the colors that would be right for my personality and my home. My project had a dedicated project manager who kept us in the loop the whole time and made sure my husband and I were happy every step of the way. On schedule, no surprise fees, and incredibly professional and knowledgeable. I've already reached out to them for another project. Five stars for Sebastian, Reed, and the whole team!

I got quotes from several painting companies around Atlanta, and OVO Painting immediately stood out. Sebastian, the owner, was the only one who took the time to point out concerns he noticed with our home that could potentially cause issues down the road if they weren’t addressed. He never tried to upsell us—in fact, he recommended other companies we could contact to evaluate those concerns and make sure there wasn’t a larger issue before he proceeded with any work and to ensure he wasn't just quoting us on things that didn't really need work.

He came prepared with the proper equipment, took measurements, and spent a significant amount of time thoroughly assessing our home before putting together the quote. He then sat down with us, walked us through everything, and took the time to answer all of our questions. That level of care, honesty, and attention to detail is ultimately what made Sebastian and his company stand out from everyone else we met with and why we chose OVO.

Once the project started, we were just as impressed with his team. They were friendly, efficient, and did great work, and they were always quick to address or remedy anything we had questions or concerns about or add one some extra things we ended up wanting to do along the way. They also handled some carpentry and repair work along the way to patch up areas that needed attention, which made the entire process feel incredibly thorough from start to finish.

We are so happy we chose Sebastian and his team. We absolutely love how our house turned out and couldn’t be happier with the work they did and already plan to work with them in the future.

Sebastian & his crew at OVO Painting were amazing to work with on the painting & wallpaper job they completed in my home. I loved the transparency provided through their quoting process via the PaintScout app. Sebastian was communicative throughout & stopped by several times to ensure the crew was on track. They have a great eye for detail & came back in with a fine tooth comb at the end of the job to ensure perfection. I would definitely recommend OVO Painting if you are in need of any paint/wallpaper work.

We hired OVO Painting Company to paint the exterior of our home, and the experience exceeded our expectations in every way.

What immediately set them apart was something so simple yet so meaningful — every morning, they knocked when they arrived, and every evening, they said goodnight before leaving. It sounds like a small thing, but in all our years of working with contractors, not one had ever done that. It made us feel respected in our own home from day one.

Sebastion, the owner, was incredibly responsive throughout the entire project — never had to wait long for a reply or wonder what was happening. And Abi, our project manager, was absolutely terrific. He and his team were uber professional at every stage — organized, courteous, and clearly took great pride in their work. The pricing and service were completely transparent from the start, with no hidden add-ons or surprise charges once the job got underway. What they quoted is what we paid, and that kind of honesty means everything.

The work itself speaks for itself — our home looks beautiful. We couldn't recommend OVO Painting Company more highly — and we're already looking forward to having them back for the interior!

I’d give OVO Painting 5/5 any day! I honestly wish I could give more. Sebastian was responsive from the start making the color selection process easy and stress-free. The project manager kept me informed throughout, and the crew was professional, respectful, and efficient. The work was completed quickly and the quality was outstanding. I especially appreciated how they handled an issue midway through by offering clear options, honest opinions and simple solutions. Highly recommend OVO Painting to anyone needing painting done!
